title: LegalDocument
description: A single ingested source document (statute section or case). Hand-authored to mirror the `documents` table (migrations/postgres/0001_init.sql) and legal_models.orm.Document — there is no pydantic equivalent yet to generate this from, so keep both in sync manually until one exists.

citation.description: Human-readable legal citation, e.g. 'RPAPL § 711'. Independent of the source API's internal id.

source_id.description: lawId+locationId for statutes, or the seed case key for cases.

version.description: Incremented on re-ingestion of a changed document. raw_snapshot is never mutated in place.

raw_snapshot.description: Immutable raw fetched/seed payload for this document version.
